rows.text: You're a desk jockey in Duomension City, trading your finite life for a finite paycheck. After surviving the fourth "crunch week" of the month, you finally get a half-day off.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You're wandering the streets of Planarcadia when an ice cream truck appears. Standing behind it is a strange guy in a top hat, looking like he just stepped out of a circus.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Vacations are what segment our lives," the strange vendor says. "When you're a student, one segment is four months. When you work, one segment is seven days. And if you're a real unlucky soul, who knows how long a segment lasts!"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "But I can sell you these instead." He flips open a storage chest to reveal a collection of colorful vacations. They're plump and shimmering, looking like they'd burst with sweet nectar if you took a bite.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You shake your head and walk away, never to see that vendor again. At the end of the month, you notice a nice little bonus in your paycheck for all that overtime.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You get into a brawl with the vendor. But just as your ultimate is about to clock him right in the nose, he and his ice cream truck vanish into thin air.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The crowd bursts into applause, and the Wishpower that was meant for him ends up going to you instead.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Thanks for your business," says the man in the top hat. He hands you an orange-yellow chunk, grinning with teeth of the exact same color.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
